gd.learn.title: How to use TerraOrb Learn Mode
gd.learn.intro: Learn Mode is for children and students. It has picture stories, little games and challenges about water, weather and farming. No account is needed; your progress is saved on your own device. Start with a lesson.
gd.learn.lessons.name: Little Lessons
gd.learn.lessons.what: Sixteen picture stories about water, weather and climate, each with a small game at the end.
gd.learn.lessons.step3: Press 'Next' to move through the pictures.
gd.learn.lessons.step4: Play the small game at the end to win stars.
gd.learn.lessons.tip: The lessons tell general facts, not facts about one tank. Some pictures have a short animation.
gd.learn.kids.name: Little Farmers' Games
gd.learn.kids.what: Tiny games for small children: match crops, sort big and small drinkers, grow a plant and guess Maha or Yala. A drop guide gives one short sentence.
gd.learn.kids.step2: Pick a game, for example 'Match the crops'.
gd.learn.kids.step3: Follow the short sentence from the guide.
gd.learn.kids.step4: Press 'Play again' to try for more stars.
gd.learn.kids.tip: In 'Match the crops' the levels open one by one, from 6 to 24 cards. The games use real crop water needs.
gd.learn.cloud.name: Rain Cloud
gd.learn.cloud.what: A game where you fly a rain cloud over the warm sea to fill it, then over the land to rain on the village tanks. There are five levels.
gd.learn.cloud.step3: Slide the slider to move the cloud left and right.
gd.learn.cloud.step4: Stay on warm sea water to fill the cloud, then stop over a tank to rain on it.
gd.learn.cloud.tip: The sea-warmth map is game art, not real data.
gd.learn.play.name: Tank Farmer and My Farm
gd.learn.play.what: Catch raindrops to fill the tank, then feed thirsty crops. The cups you catch let you plant and grow your own farm of 8 crops.
gd.learn.play.step2: Press 'Play!' and tap the raindrops before they fall.
gd.learn.play.step3: Tap each thirsty crop to give it a cup of water.
gd.learn.play.step4: Open 'My Farm' to plant crops and water them to level 5.
gd.learn.play.tip: How much water each crop needs comes from the site's real crop numbers (draft values). Your farm is saved only on this device.
gd.learn.challenges.name: Challenges
gd.learn.challenges.what: Practice games for students: a quick quiz, a water ladder and 'Pick the week'. Two of them use real tank data.
gd.learn.challenges.step2: Choose 'Quick quiz', 'Water ladder' or 'Pick the week'.
gd.learn.challenges.step3: Answer the questions or tap the squares.
gd.learn.challenges.step4: Read the short reason shown after each answer.
gd.learn.challenges.tip: The quiz uses fixed facts. 'Water ladder' and 'Pick the week' use real tank and sowing calendar data, so they need the data to load.
gd.learn.rewards.name: My rewards
gd.learn.rewards.what: Shows your level, drops, badges and lesson cards, and a certificate you can print.
gd.learn.rewards.step2: See your level, drops and badges.
gd.learn.rewards.step3: Finish all Little Lessons to unlock the certificate.
gd.learn.rewards.step4: Type your name, press 'Show my certificate', then 'Print'.
gd.learn.rewards.tip: Rewards are saved only in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere. 'Reset my rewards' erases them.
